newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand to grant three new mobile phone licences.
newsitem.headline: Thailand to grant three new mobile phone licences.

text.p: Thailand's Transport and Communication Ministry plans to grant three new mobile phone licences as part of government policy to liberalise the telecommunications market, a senior official said on Tuesday.
The new mobile phone operators will be allowed to operate in the frequency of 1500 and 1900 MHz, Mahidol Chantrangkurn, the permanent secretary of the transport ministry, told Reuters.
Mahidol, who was speaking after the ministry's board meeting, said the plan will need to receive final approval from the cabinet.

The new operators will be granted 25-year concessions and must allow the state agencies -- either Telephone Organisation of Thailand or Communication Authority of Thailand -- to have a stake in their venture, he said.
There are currently three private mobile phone operators in Thailand -- Advanced Info Service, Total Access Communication Plc and Wireless Communications Service Plc (WCS).
WCS is a joint venture between International Engineering Plc and Total Access.
